title: 1:1 Scale Space Shuttle on Launch Pad
author: FlyingPenguin33

title.es: Transbordador Espacial en Plataforma de Lanzamiento
title.pt: Ônibus Espacial na Plataforma de Lançamento

generated.description: A 1:1 scale replica of a space shuttle standing on its launch pad, built mostly from iron blocks with white, red, and orange wool for the orbiter and external tank details. It is about 76 wide, 105 high, and 91 deep, made of roughly 37,600 blocks, with a small chest as the only block entity and a flat stone and cobblestone pad beneath it.
